display_name: Phase1 source L_s receiver-crossfit reliability router
description: Train per-candidate correctness scores using fixed confidence and waveform-comparison features, fit on other source receivers and score heldout decisions.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: 19 fixed label-invariant features per candidate: F confidence, embedding similarity, candidate agreement and waveform distance; no new IQ inference
data.tx_sets_ref: Only legitimate source L_s truth after all predictions fixed; no U_s truth, V or test read

permissions.query_use: Legal source L_s labels are loaded together; each fold fits only other receivers labels, heldout receiver labels do not enter that fold fit or decision. No U_s truth, V, or target data.
permissions.claim_scope: Source L_s data previously used by ground F and/or prior views; not independent blind or target test

checkpoint.initialization: Five source-trained standard-scaled regularized logistic models, each fit only on other receiver L_s correctness; DURA is baseline candidate.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: All 1047 source prediction cohorts and common clean/raw/DURA/parent decisions must match before source truth
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed logistic C=.1, max_iter1000, independent training per fold; fixed score margins 0/.05/.1; no automatic target test or holdout-based model selection.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Each receiver fold fits only other receivers L_s labels; L_s metadata loaded together. All heldout predictions fixed before score; logistic scores may be miscalibrated across receivers.

rows.purpose: test confidence and waveform comparison cues for choosing fixed source candidates
rows.seed_notes: Deterministic lbfgs fit per candidate and receiver; fixed source feature inputs, no additional stochastic sample selection.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Fitted on source L_s label correctness of other receivers per fold; all legal L_s metadata are loaded together.
Previously explored source records; frozen F trained on source, no independent-test claim.
DURA is a fixed candidate; test-time selector sees candidate confidence and relative features, never true identity.
No U_s truth, V or target data.
